Concatenating two 2^31-char strings must die from Rakudo's string-length limit; an implementation limit, not language semantics.
Uses $?LANG.refine_slang with grammar and actions roles at BEGIN; this is Rakudo's slang API, which the file itself says is not spec.
Calls Rakudo::Deprecations.DEPRECATED with :lang-vers; Rakudo-internal deprecation machinery.
Checks arity/Mu params of every setting proto vs candidates; also stopped compiling Rakudo's lib/experimental.rakumod (native int1 is repr).
Asserts CORE-SETTING-REV numbers, PseudoStash.^ver, and v6.d.TEST/TESTDEPR/NOMOD modifiers, which are Rakudo setting internals.
`-V` output must contain Raku::implementation=Rakudo, a Rakudo-specific CLI flag and config dump.
Uses nqp::getcomp('Raku').compile with outer_ctx, ForeignCode and nqp::forceouterctx at BEGIN time.
Needs $*RAKU.compiler.id as a 40-hex digest distinct between RAKUDO_RAKUAST frontends; Rakudo frontend/precomp internals.
Rakudo makes an unbound runtime lexical read as Mu inside a BEGIN-time constant; Raku++ sees the value, an accidental Rakudo artifact.
A Raku-level HOW doing Metamodel::Naming reads the role's private $!name attribute; depends on Rakudo metamodel internals.
dd of a Failure must not mark it handled/throw at exit and must print Rakudo's dd format only.
Needs CompUnit::DependencySpecification with .raku round-trip of auth/version/api matchers; precomp-store implementation class.
Needs Rakudo's DUMP() routine and its output format.
`enum $foo <...>` already dies; test needs the exception type to be X::Comp::NYI.
Starts with introspecting the Rakudo-generated POPULATE submethod; crash at test 3 hides later construction-semantics assertions.
Already dies for a non-Match TOP/rule return; needs Rakudo's "'TOP' returned a Int object (42) rather than a Match object" message.
Wants INIT of a not-yet-bound alias, and `constant K = INIT 42`, to yield Mu, which is a Rakudo VMNull artefact.
Wants `my %h{C} is Hash[Int]` to be named 'Hash[Int][Any,C]', a doubly-parameterized name that looks like a Rakudo artefact.
Raku++ already rejects str to int/num params at runtime; tests want Rakudo's compile-time 'will never work' wording.
Postfix ++ on a read-only native parameter dies, but Raku++ gives a multi-NoMatch where the test wants an immutability ('mutable') message.
Raku++ already quits with the spawn error (X::OS); the test wants Rakudo's X::AdHoc as the exception type.
-I with a custom CompUnit::Repository class spec, then scans precomp dependency headers through Rakudo::Internals.DIR-RECURSE.
Precompiles Rakudo's NativeCall via CompUnit::PrecompilationRepository internals and compares bytecode checksums for reproducibility.
Remaining tests require compiling Rakudo's own lib/NativeCall/Types.rakumod (`our native long ... is repr<P6int>`); the require logic itself passes.
Mostly relies on Rakudo numifying adverbs' .Bool results (strings, Nil) to count :v/:k/:kv/:p; type-object adverb parts are LANG.
Rakudo discards the Int in `Int [$a, $b]`, typing the parameter as bare Positional so a plain Array binds.
Tests Rakudo::Internals::SupplySequencer directly.
Asserts Rakudo's exact error-message text, typo suggestions and hints across many exception cases.
Expects .roll/.indent with huge bigint counts to die with a native-unbox error; a MoarVM int-width limit, not language.
Loads Test::Helpers::QAST using nqp::getcomp; asserts QAST shape of .= codegen.
